caseName: City of Coral Gables v. Wright
caseNameFull: City of Coral Gables v. Wright, doing business as Ed. C. Wright & Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Morton B. Adams and Ira C. Haycock, with whom Mr. D. H. Redfearn was on the brief, for petitioner. Mr. Miller Walton for Ed. C. Wright and Mr. F. A. Berry for the American National Bank of Nashville,—respondents. Mr. W. Terry Gibson filed a brief, as amicus curiae, in support of respondents.

opinions.text:
Certiorari, 320 U. S. 729, to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court. Me. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
